name: Summit AZ - Fixture Installation City Pages
body:
> Plan · Summit Az · 2026-10-09

# Summary
Rewrites of four plumbing fixture installation city pages that were city-swap copies stuck in "Crawled - currently not indexed". Queen Creek was done Sep 25; Gilbert, Tempe and Apache Junction followed Oct 9 after the Guardian review blocked their live copy. Gilbert then got a second, generic-content revision the same day.

# Pages
| City | Page ID | Files | Supporting keywords | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Queen Creek | 10219 | `Summit-AZ-Fixture-Installation-Queen-Creek-Draft-2026-09-25.md` | plumbing fixture replacement (880 / 16), bathroom remodel plumbing (720 / 7), angle stop replacement (140 / 15) | Live Sep 25; card layout fixed Oct 9 |
| Gilbert | 10216 | `...-Gilbert-Draft-2026-10-09.md`, `Summit-AZ-Fixture-Gilbert-Generic-Review-2026-10-09.md`, `Summit-AZ-Fixture-Gilbert-Revision-Draft-2026-10-09.md` | tub replacement (9,900 / 19), bathtub installation (4,400 / 28) | Live Oct 9, revised Oct 9 |
| Tempe | 10222 | `...-Tempe-Draft-2026-10-09.md` | low flow fixtures (880 / 26), plumbing fixture repair (140 / 21) | Live Oct 9 |
| Apache Junction | 10213 | `...-Apache-Junction-Draft-2026-10-09.md` | toilet installation service (4,400 / 33, added by Kim), frost free hose bib (8,100 / 24) | Live Oct 9 |

Primary keyword on all: "plumbing fixture installation" + city (260 / KD 17). Keyword assignment: `Summit-AZ-Fixture-3-Cities-Keywords-2026-10-09.md` (Search Atlas project 5105002, approved by Kim Oct 9).

# Common fixes
- Removed pasted chat-app HTML blocks (6 per page), commercial wording ("offices, restaurants", "Home or Business"), flat-rate and competitive pricing, "all major brands", same-day scheduling, "Fast Response" badges and brand names.
- Short titles such as "Plumbing Fixture Installation in Tempe, AZ | Summit" (approved by Kim).
- Scope (Kim, Oct 9): Summit does tub replacement and bathtub installation, plumbing side only; tile and demolition are left to the remodeler.

# Gilbert generic-content review
- Test: every section must say something true for Gilbert (sourced) or for Summit (verified). Verdicts KEEP, REWRITE, NEEDS SUMMIT INPUT, TRIM.
- Five Town of Gilbert facts added (hardness 8 to 10 gpg with a 10 to 12 softener setting, brown water guidance, free water efficiency checkup, leak video series, no indoor fixture rebate). EPA mentions cut from 7 to 1.
- Still waiting on Summit: whether the "Details We Check" boxes are real checks.
